item.description:
What's New in v2.7.0

  • Dashboard statistics are now stored separately from your transcripts, so deleting history no longer resets them. Existing history is imported once.
  • AI enhancement works again. It runs after the paste instead of before it, so dictation stays instant.
  • New output modes: Instant, Instant + Refine, and Enhanced.
  • Every setting now explains itself, with a full documentation site behind the info icons.
  • Fixed: an unset retention period could delete your entire transcript history at launch.
